description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of four different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, GRPO, and SRPO—as applied to three distinct datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis categorizes the datasets, while the vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)," uses a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2 percentage points. Each dataset is represented by a group of four bars, each corresponding to one of the methods, distinguished by color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), and SRPO (solid orange). For Mathverse, the accuracy values are approximately 53.2% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 53.4% for DAPO, 53.4% for GRPO, and 55.8% for SRPO. For MMLU, the values are approximately 56.7% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 56.0% for DAPO, 55.8% for GRPO, and 57.2% for SRPO. For Physics, the values are approximately 61.2% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 57.6% for DAPO, 57.8% for GRPO, and 60.9% for SRPO. The bars are arranged in groups with each method's bar within a dataset visually aligned vertically, and the chart does not indicate any sorting of the bars by height or alphabetical order.
